items.summary: Instrumental आपसे could not convert to तुझसे or तुमसे.
items.resolution: Added instrumental/ablative forms across all six tiers and phrase-aware replacement.
items.verification: 144/144 transformation cases and 48/48 smoke cases pass.

items.summary: Other postpositional cases and spelling variants were not explicit.
items.resolution: Added में, पर/पे, and तक forms; documented साथ, लिए, पास, and बारे में as covered oblique constructions.
items.verification: Joined and split variants have regression tests.

items.summary: Three Full Informal sentences are detected as Respectful Casual.
items.linguistic_reason: They use accepted तुम morphology, identical to the Respectful Casual paradigm without scenario context.

items.summary: Three Full Formal sentences are detected as Formal.
items.linguistic_reason: आप morphology and respectful-plural agreement are shared, and these sentences lack an overt strict-formality marker.

items.summary: Six Formal-Warm sentences are detected as Formal or Full Formal.
items.linguistic_reason: Warmth comes from the elder-relative relationship; without an overt kinship address term it is not recoverable from आप morphology.

items.summary: Special tiers did not consume validated scenario-level address overrides.
items.resolution: Formal-Warm now validates elder_relative terms and Reverse Formal validates customer_facing terms without guessing kinship.

items.summary: Addressee agreement could have flattened service-worker self-reference.
items.resolution: First-person हूं/हूँ clauses are explicitly excluded from addressee rewrites and tested for masculine, feminine, and mixed clauses.
